title: Stack the OPUS MAXIMUS branch on PR #178, the existing one-machine integration trunk, instead of offering a second trunk
problem: On 2026-10-15 a fresh read of the open PRs showed draft #178 (head 4ed91f7, created 2026-10-14 16:22, base #175 e34dfe0) declaring itself the integration trunk. It independently built a whole-machine test, the signed organ exchange on the mission path, the reconciliation-record fix and the removal of silent server-side model fallback. This session's unpushed branch (#175 + #169@94d4289 + six commits) built the same four things in parallel. Pushing it as a second trunk would recreate the divergence the founder prohibited ('Do not create a parallel GREG'). This record supersedes the trunk choice of OPUS-MAXIMUS-TRUNK-20261014 (#175 + #169), which stays as lineage.
founder_intent_refs: FABLE 5.1 OPUS MAXIMUS execution command, 2026-10-14 (chat text; founder authentication not claimed)
baseline: #178 4ed91f7: its whole-machine test, 42/42 attack matrix and CI job 8 (its own record). This branch before the merge: 6a16a9e, the ten-step proof passing with stand-in and with real organs. git rev-list --left-right --count 6a16a9e...4ed91f7 = 18 | 47 (merge base e34dfe0). git merge produced ten conflicted files.

alternatives.name: proposed_design
alternatives.description: Merge #178 into this branch with a merge commit and open the draft PR with base claude/greg-one-machine, so its diff is only what #178 lacks: #169's increments after 9c46810 up to 94d4289 (bubblewrap worker envelope, relay door, owner-session console, mission trace script, discovery), the worker-envelope symlink fix, the founder-signed script worker, the alternate organ exchange, the founder-correction learning proof and its tie-break fix, the ten-step supervised proof, the resilience one-outcome rule, the SDK test import fix, and the source and intent documents. Where both sides fixed the same defect, #178's version is kept.
advantages: One trunk (#178) plus one stacked PR; no second trunk.
Both histories kept by merge commits; nothing is rewritten.
#178's stricter fixes (model identity, reconciliation spend booking, trusted-git digests) win over this branch's earlier versions.
disadvantages: The stacked PR still carries a large diff (all of #169's later increments).
The worker dispatch path changes #178's behaviour: workers now require the bubblewrap envelope, which #178 had left out as a founder decision.
Two organ-exchange capabilities exist (organ.exchange canonical, organs.exchange alternate).

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: Abandon this branch and leave its findings as comments on #178.
advantages: Zero merge work; #178 stays as it is.
disadvantages: Loses executed, tested work #178 names as its next requirements (founder-correction learning) and #169's later increments.
Comments are not code; a later session must rebuild it.
alternatives.revival_evidence: If the merged tree cannot be made green, fall back to this and attach the findings to #178.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: Push this branch as an independent trunk against main and ask the founder to choose between it and #178.
disadvantages: Two trunks for one machine: the exact divergence the directive forbids.
The founder would arbitrate engineering duplication.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Only if #178 is closed or abandoned by its owner.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Merge in a separate worktree and run both whole-machine proofs and the full suite on the merged tree before committing to it.
advantages: The decision rests on executed evidence on the actual merged tree.
alternatives.revival_evidence: This is how the proposed design was executed (worktree uk-conv).

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Two unreconciled trunks; the next session re-derives which is canonical.
disadvantages: Violates 'Do not create a parallel GREG' and the convergence intent.

roles.position: The founder wants one machine. #178 already declares the trunk; this work should strengthen it, not compete with it. The five roles are performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: Stacking is not adoption into main; that stays the founder's decision.

roles.position: Duplicate fixes resolve to #178's versions. The real fork is worker confinement: #169's envelope (fail closed without bubblewrap) versus #178's supervision without OS confinement. The envelope is kept because an unconfined worker shares the body's UID and could read its keys; #178's in-memory git digests are added behind it.
material_concerns: Workers become unavailable on hosts without bubblewrap and unprivileged user namespaces, including macOS.

roles.position: The merge composes two independently reviewed lines at the worker path; the ten conflicted files were resolved by one agent. #178's CI job 8 runs on GitHub runners where bubblewrap may be absent, so the envelope could turn its merge gate red.
material_concerns: CI job 8 on runners without bubblewrap.

roles.position: One trunk is cheaper to maintain than two. The stacked PR keeps review scoped to what #178 lacks.
material_concerns: #169 (2fcd872) and #175 (0ae4c94) moved again on 2026-10-15; they are the next merges.
evidence_refs: git rev-list counts recorded in REPOSITORY_CONVERGENCE_MAP.md

roles.position: No external effect, spend or publication. VEPMC stays 0 and both proofs assert it. Fail-closed confinement protects the founder's keys at the cost of availability.
material_concerns: Do not report the merged tree as more reviewed than it is.

evidence.finding: Both lines built a whole-machine test, an organ exchange on the mission path, the reconciliation-record fix and model-identity governance.

pass_1.intended_outcome: One trunk for the whole machine: #178, with this session's unique, tested work stacked on it and every duplicate resolved to one canonical version.

advantages.amplified_value: Every later session converges on one line; reverses into a liability if the stacked PR silently changes #178's semantics, so each change of #178 behaviour is named in the PR (worker confinement).

advantages.statement: Duplicates resolve to the stricter version.
advantages.amplified_value: The canonical code is the better-reviewed one; reverses if the stricter version drops a test this branch found, so this branch's regression tests are adapted to #178's semantics and kept.
The trunk's own gap list shrinks with evidence; reverses if the learning proof depends on code #178 lacks, so it runs on the merged tree.

disadvantages.redesigned_response: Fail closed is kept as the safe default and recorded as NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION with both options; #178's digest checks are added so the protection is layered, not swapped.
Bounded and listed: the PR states exactly which commits it adds over #178.

organ.exchange (#178) is canonical on the one-machine mission; organs.exchange is a registered alternate with replay-protected bridge state and the DALEOBANKS ledger acceptance record, kept per the Final Build Order.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the stacked branch as if adopted: CI regressions from the envelope, a reviewer believing #178's supervision record still describes the worker, the alternate organ exchange drifting from the canonical one, and the word 'trunk' read as adoption.

new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: The PR states the dependency; the next CI result on the stacked branch decides whether the job installs bubblewrap or the founder chooses #178's unconfined mode.

new_weaknesses.statement: #178's SUPERVISION constant described an unconfined worker.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Removed with its only caller; the worker report carries the envelope's own isolation evidence instead.
Draft PR; adoption into main and which line is canonical stay NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION.

migration_plan: Merge 4ed91f7 into 6a16a9e in a separate worktree; resolve ten files; adapt this branch's regression tests to #178's canonical semantics; run targeted suites, both whole-machine proofs and the full suite on the merged tree; commit; push; open the draft PR with base claude/greg-one-machine.

After push: revert the merge commit; #178 is untouched by this work.

kill_criteria: The merged tree cannot pass both whole-machine proofs and the full suite without weakening a test from either line.
The worker-path composition is found to weaken #178's git-tamper protections.
The branch is used to claim founder-device, external or commercial evidence.
